name: toolshop-api
description: Testes automatizados da API da Toolshop (Practice Software Testing) com Cucumber, Playwright e TypeScript, em Gherkin (português).

scripts.test:lento: docker exec -d pst-laravel-api-1 php artisan queue:work --max-time=300 && cucumber-js -p lento
scripts.db:reset: docker exec pst-laravel-api-1 php artisan migrate:fresh --seed && docker exec pst-laravel-api-1 php artisan invoice:remove && docker exec -u root pst-laravel-api-1 chown -R www-data:www-data storage bootstrap/cache

author: Arthur Evangelista
